**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] The plugin loads through the supported Omarchy plugin contract.
- [ ] Its panel is positioned correctly on every supported bar position.
- [ ] Unsupported appearance controls are not shown.
- [ ] Missing optional capabilities have a safe fallback.
- [ ] V1, V2, multi-monitor, and mixed-scale behavior is documented and tested.
